main_text.p: vertetur, in tam fertili medi-cinę agro, à diligentissimis illis, qui me præcesserunt, messoribus, relicta spicilegia, non mediocrem prouentus accessionem rei medicæ fa-ctura, postremus ego & infi-mus messor, ficilirem. Publi-ca igitur vtilitas, cupiditas voluntati meæ satisfaciendi, & auctores viri graues, qui-bus hoc scriptum meum pla-cere & probari intellexi, me ad hunc fœtum excluden-dum compulerunt, cuius ca-put ac pectus, vobis, Serenis-simi Principes offero atque commendo, humiliter rogi-tans,

page.notes: Catchword "tans," is at the foot right, below the last line; it is also the last word of the text and is therefore given once as catchword. Page number not printed. Signature "A 5" at the foot.
